enums.name: ke_result_domain
enums.doc: The domains that own a range of result codes. A domain's own codes are written `KE_RESULT_CODE(KE_RESULT_DOMAIN_ <DOMAIN >, n)` in its header, with `n` from 1 up.

enums.name: ke_result
enums.doc: What a fallible call returns: `KE_OK`, or the code of the failure. The detail of a failure goes to the failing library's log, never into the code. A caller treats a code it does not know as `KE_RESULT_GENERAL`. Ignoring the result of a call is a compiler warning where the compiler supports it.

values.name: KE_GPU_COMPARE_UNDEFINED
values.doc: No comparison (default for samplers without shadow compare)

enums.name: ke_gpu_shader_language
enums.doc: Shader source language a device accepts. Query via `ke_gpu_device::shader_language`.

enums.name: ke_render_stage
enums.doc: Where a pass that works on the frame's color runs. The stages run in this order, and the passes of one stage in the order they joined. Stages up to KE_RENDER_STAGE_HDR_POST draw in the service's color format, the later ones in the backbuffer's.

enums.name: ke_render_chain_mode
enums.doc: What a pass in the chain does with the frame's color.

values.name: KE_RENDER_CHAIN_SAMPLE_OVER
values.doc: Samples the current color, through the context's color_source, and draws over a copy of it, which becomes the current color.

values.name: KE_RENDER_CHAIN_REPLACE
values.doc: Samples the current color and writes every texel of a new one, which becomes the current color.

enums.name: ke_render_depth_mode
enums.doc: How a pass's render pass uses the frame's depth.

values.name: KE_RENDER_DEPTH_TEST
values.doc: Attached and tested against; the pass's pipeline does not write it.

structs.name: ke_vec2
structs.doc: Two floats, x then y.

structs.name: ke_vec3
structs.doc: Three floats, x then y then z.

structs.name: ke_vec4
structs.doc: Four floats, x then y then z then w.

structs.name: ke_quat
structs.doc: A rotation; the four lanes are x, y, z, w.

structs.name: ke_mat4
structs.doc: Sixteen floats.

structs.name: ke_transform
structs.doc: Spatial transform: where a thing is, how it is turned, and how big it is.

structs.name: ke_variant_table_entry
structs.doc: One authored key and its value. Whoever accepts the key sets `consumed`; the loader reports every entry left unclaimed.

structs.name: ke_component_field
structs.doc: One field of a component: where it lies, what a scene writes into it, and the names an integer field may be written as.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: The name a scene writes the field by.

fields.name: default_value
fields.doc: What the field holds when nothing authors it. KE_VARIANT_NULL means the header declared no default and zero stands.

fields.name: enum_names
fields.doc: The names a scene may write for an integer field, in value order; a name stands for its index. None leaves the field numeric.

fields.name: enum_count
fields.doc: Entries in `enum_names`.

fields.name: copy_bytes_per_row_alignment
fields.doc: Byte multiple a texture/buffer copy's bytes_per_row must be a multiple of; 1 when the backend imposes none.

fields.name: z_zero_to_one
fields.doc: True when clip z is in [0,1] (Vulkan/D3D/WebGPU), false for [-1,1] (GL).

fields.name: y_flip
fields.doc: True when a top-left framebuffer origin needs a Y flip in projection.

structs.name: ke_vertex
structs.doc: Per-vertex data of a mesh, as authored.

fields.name: x
fields.doc: Object-space position

fields.name: y
fields.doc: Object-space position

fields.name: z
fields.doc: Object-space position

fields.name: nx
fields.doc: Object-space normal (normalized)

fields.name: ny
fields.doc: Object-space normal (normalized)

fields.name: nz
fields.doc: Object-space normal (normalized)

fields.name: u
fields.doc: UV texture coordinates

fields.name: v
fields.doc: UV texture coordinates

fields.name: tx
fields.doc: Object-space tangent (normalized)

fields.name: ty
fields.doc: Object-space tangent (normalized)

fields.name: tz
fields.doc: Object-space tangent (normalized)

fields.name: tw
fields.doc: Bitangent sign: +1 or -1 (bitangent = cross(N,T)*tw)

structs.name: ke_mesh_vertex
structs.doc: One interleaved vertex as a mesh is uploaded to the device.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: The label the resource is debugged under; the service makes it unique.

fields.name: width
fields.doc: Read when size_mode is ABSOLUTE.

fields.name: scale_x
fields.doc: Read when size_mode is RELATIVE_TO_BACKBUFFER.

fields.name: clear_value
fields.doc: Per-resource clear color.

structs.name: ke_render_frame_globals
structs.doc: What every shader reads about the frame being drawn, under the parameter `ke_frame`. Matrices are stored the way the math library stores them.

fields.name: camera_pos
fields.doc: World position of the camera in xyz; w is 1.

fields.name: viewport
fields.doc: Backbuffer width and height in pixels in xy; zw are 0.

fields.name: time
fields.doc: Seconds since the first frame.

fields.name: dt
fields.doc: Seconds since the previous frame.

structs.name: ke_render_lighting
structs.doc: The scene's light that every lit shader reads, under the parameter `ke_lighting`.

fields.name: direction
fields.doc: Direction the directional light travels in xyz; w is 1 when the scene has one, else 0.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Color of the directional light in rgb; a is its intensity.

fields.name: ambient
fields.doc: Ambient color in rgb; a is 0.

structs.name: ke_render_pass_io
structs.doc: A pass's declared resource I/O. Every write is cleared when the pass's render pass opens. A pass in the chain draws into the frame's color as its first color attachment, before its writes.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Optional name the pass's render or compute pass is labeled with; copied when the pass begins.

fields.name: reads
fields.doc: The resources the pass reads.

fields.name: writes
fields.doc: The resources the pass writes.

fields.name: chain
fields.doc: The pass's link, or KE_RENDER_CHAIN_NONE for a pass outside the chain.

fields.name: depth
fields.doc: How the frame's depth is attached; ignored when a write is already a depth resource.

structs.name: ke_transform_component
structs.doc: An entity's authored 3D pose.

structs.name: ke_transform2d_component
structs.doc: An entity's authored 2D pose, read and written as one unit.

fields.name: rotation
fields.doc: Radians, CCW positive.

fields.name: depth
fields.doc: Where the plane sits along Z.

structs.name: ke_world_transform_component
structs.doc: An entity's place in world space, composed down the hierarchy. Written by the hierarchy alone.

structs.name: ke_camera_component
structs.doc: Scene node that drives the per-frame view/projection. The first entity with a Camera in the ECS becomes the active camera.

fields.name: cull_mask
fields.doc: Which of the 32 view layers this camera draws. A renderable is skipped unless one of its own layer bits is set here.

structs.name: ke_directional_light_component
structs.doc: Directional light node. Its properties give the light's direction, color, intensity and ambient term.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Linear RGB.

structs.name: ke_point_light_component
structs.doc: Point light node — emits light in all directions from this entity's world position.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Linear RGB.

structs.name: ke_spot_light_component
structs.doc: Spot light node — emits a cone of light from this entity's world position.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Linear RGB.

structs.name: ke_ambient_light_component
structs.doc: Scene-wide ambient light node. First entity with this component wins.

structs.name: ke_skybox_component
structs.doc: Environment cubemap driving both the skybox and image-based lighting. Only the first entity carrying one wins per frame.

structs.name: ke_mesh_component
structs.doc: Renders a mesh with a material. `mesh` and `material` double as output: the engine fills them, at KE_PHASE_UPDATE, whenever `primitive` names a known shape and/or the surface fields below have not already resolved to a valid handle. A caller holding real handles writes them and leaves `primitive` empty; the engine only acts where a handle is still invalid.

fields.name: primitive
fields.doc: Resolved into `mesh` by the engine; a node authoring `mesh` directly would have the value overwritten.

fields.name: layers
fields.doc: Which of the 32 view layers this renderable occupies. A camera draws it only when its cull_mask names one of these bits.

structs.name: ke_sprite2d_component
structs.doc: A textured quad in the plane, resolved into geometry and a material by the engine.

fields.name: texture
fields.doc: Image to sample. Empty draws the plain tinted quad.

fields.name: region
fields.doc: Rectangle of the image to draw, normalized: x, y, width, height.

fields.name: size
fields.doc: Size in world units, multiplying the node's scale.

fields.name: pivot
fields.doc: Point of the quad the node's origin sits on, normalized; 0,0 is the bottom-left corner.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Multiplies the sampled image. Linear RGBA.

fields.name: texture_handle
fields.doc: The image resolved from `texture`.

fields.name: attached
fields.doc: Whether the quad this sprite draws through has been attached.

structs.name: ke_camera_frustum
structs.doc: The perspective frustum a camera's field of view describes.

fields.name: tan_half_fov_y
fields.doc: Tangent of half the vertical field of view.

structs.name: ke_render_scene_component_ids
structs.doc: The ids the ecs gave the scene's render components, which the passes are created with.

structs.name: ke_render_gbuffer_resources
structs.doc: The resources a gbuffer pass writes, as the render service's ids. Every id KE_COMPONENT_INVALID stands for no gbuffer.

fields.name: albedo
fields.doc: The base color.

fields.name: normal
fields.doc: The world normal.

fields.name: emissive
fields.doc: The emitted light.

structs.name: ke_render_shadow_resources
structs.doc: The resources a directional shadow pass writes, as the render service's ids. Every id KE_COMPONENT_INVALID stands for no shadow, which a reader meets with the neutral one.

fields.name: map
fields.doc: The shadow map.

fields.name: light
fields.doc: The buffer holding the light's view-projection.

structs.name: ke_render_cluster_resources
structs.doc: The resources a light-cluster pass writes, as the render service's ids. Every id KE_COMPONENT_INVALID stands for no clustered light.

fields.name: tag
fields.doc: The tag the pass writes, which orders its readers after it.

fields.name: point_lights
fields.doc: The clustered point lights.

fields.name: spot_lights
fields.doc: The clustered spot lights.

fields.name: point_indices
fields.doc: The point light indices of each cluster.

fields.name: point_counts
fields.doc: The point light count of each cluster.

fields.name: spot_indices
fields.doc: The spot light indices of each cluster.

fields.name: spot_counts
fields.doc: The spot light count of each cluster.

fields.name: grid
fields.doc: The cluster grid parameters.

slots.name: declare
slots.doc: Declares a transient resource the service allocates and recycles; every call declares a new one.

params.name: out_cid
params.doc: Receives the resource's id, the tag-component cid to place in a pass's access list.

slots.name: import_texture
slots.doc: Imports an externally-owned texture, labeled `name`.

slots.name: import_tag
slots.doc: Mints a resource with no GPU payload, labeled `name`, that passes order on.

slots.name: import_buffer
slots.doc: Publishes an externally-owned GPU buffer, labeled `name`, for another pass to bind by its id.

slots.name: frame_color
slots.doc: The tag a pass that joined the chain writes in its access list, and that the system ending the frame reads.

slots.name: frame_depth
slots.doc: The frame's depth texture, cleared when the frame begins.

slots.name: begin_pass
slots.doc: Opens a pass's recording context, from inside a render system's body.

slots.name: end_pass
slots.doc: Closes a recording context opened by begin_pass.

slots.name: begin_frame
slots.doc: Acquires the service's render target as the backbuffer, clears the per-pass command slot table, and clears the frame's color and depth. When the target has nothing to draw into this frame it succeeds without beginning one, and begin_pass then opens no pass; it fails with the target's code when acquiring failed.

slots.name: end_frame
slots.doc: Submits the passes outside the chain in the order they ended, then the chain in its order, then draws the frame's color into the backbuffer and presents the render target. A link whose pass recorded nothing still carries the color through it. Succeeds doing nothing when no frame began, and fails with the target's code when presenting failed.

slots.name: upload_mesh
slots.doc: Uploads interleaved vertices and 16-bit indices to device buffers.

params.name: out_mesh
params.doc: Receives the handle of the uploaded mesh.

slots.name: mesh_buffers
slots.doc: Resolves a mesh handle to its GPU buffers. Returns false for a handle this service never uploaded.

slots.name: set_clear_color
slots.doc: The color a pass clears its color attachments to (begin_render LOAD_OP_CLEAR).

params.name: rgba
params.doc: RGBA8 pixels in row order; width by height by four bytes.

params.name: out_texture
params.doc: Receives the handle of the uploaded texture.

params.name: shader
params.doc: Authored material name; NULL/empty selects the engine default.

params.name: out_material
params.doc: Receives the handle of the material.

slots.name: material_binding
slots.doc: What the service's resource binder holds for a material handle, the argument a pass gives its bind_material; an unknown handle resolves to the built-in white material.

slots.name: material_alpha_mode
slots.doc: The pass bucket for a material handle, resolved from CPU-side storage — no GPU state touched.

slots.name: material_alpha_cutoff
slots.doc: The MASK discard threshold for a material handle.

params.name: faces
params.doc: Six square RGBA8 faces, in the order +X, -X, +Y, -Y, +Z, -Z.

params.name: out_cubemap
params.doc: Receives the handle of the uploaded cubemap.

slots.name: texture_view
slots.doc: The GPU view for a texture/cubemap handle.

slots.name: resource_view
slots.doc: The GPU view of a declared resource; KE_GPU_INVALID_HANDLE for an unknown id.

slots.name: resource_texture
slots.doc: The raw GPU texture behind a declared resource, for the copy operations that take a texture rather than a view.

slots.name: resource_buffer
slots.doc: The GPU buffer published via import_buffer; KE_GPU_INVALID_HANDLE for another id.

slots.name: resource_buffer_size
slots.doc: The size (bytes) of the buffer published via import_buffer; 0 for another id.

slots.name: backbuffer_size
slots.doc: The backbuffer's pixel size, callable from any phase. Refreshed once per frame at begin_frame, so a caller earlier in the tick reads the previous frame's size.

slots.name: upload
slots.doc: Records a buffer upload to be flushed single-threaded at end_frame (before submit).

slots.name: get_or_create_pipeline
slots.doc: Returns the pipeline for this exact params state, compiling it on first request.

slots.name: material_shader
slots.doc: The authored-material shader name a material handle was created with (see create_material's `shader`).

slots.name: retain_mesh
slots.doc: Adds a reference to a mesh, keeping it resident.

slots.name: release_mesh
slots.doc: Drops a reference to a mesh, freeing it at zero.

slots.name: retain_texture
slots.doc: Adds a reference to a texture, keeping it resident.

slots.name: release_texture
slots.doc: Drops a reference to a texture, freeing it at zero.

slots.name: retain_material
slots.doc: Adds a reference to a material, keeping it resident.

slots.name: release_material
slots.doc: Drops a reference to a material, freeing it at zero.

slots.name: try_get_mesh
slots.doc: Path-keyed probe for a resident mesh upload: on a hit, retains and writes the resident handle to `out`. try_get_texture also serves cubemaps (shared cache).

params.name: out
params.doc: Receives the resident handle on a cache hit.

slots.name: try_get_texture
slots.doc: Path-keyed probe for a resident texture upload.

params.name: out
params.doc: Receives the resident handle on a cache hit.

slots.name: try_get_material
slots.doc: Path-keyed probe for a resident material.

params.name: out
params.doc: Receives the resident handle on a cache hit.

slots.name: white_texture
slots.doc: The built-in 1×1 white texture, resolvable everywhere a neutral albedo is wanted.

slots.name: load_shader
slots.doc: Resolves a shader by logical NAME + STAGE to a device-ready module.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_NOT_FOUND when no shader has that name, or the device's code when it rejects the module.

slots.name: set_frame_globals
slots.doc: Replaces the frame globals and records their upload; a shader reads them as `ke_frame`.

slots.name: frame_globals
slots.doc: The frame globals last set, zero before the first.

slots.name: set_lighting
slots.doc: Replaces the scene's light and records its upload; a shader reads it as `ke_lighting`.

slots.name: lighting
slots.doc: The scene's light last set, zero before the first.

slots.name: resource_binder
slots.doc: The resource binder the service was created with, through which a pass brings its resources to its shaders; the service has given it `ke_frame`, `ke_lighting` and the `ke_samp_*` samplers.

slots.name: backbuffer_format
slots.doc: Texel format of the backbuffer, the format a pipeline drawing into it declares.

slots.name: resource_format
slots.doc: Texel format of a texture resource, the format a pipeline drawing into it declares; KE_GPU_TEXTURE_FORMAT_INVALID for an unknown id or a resource without one.

slots.name: resource_generation
slots.doc: Counts the times the targets declared relative to the backbuffer were recreated, which `begin_frame` does when the backbuffer changes size. A pass that keeps something made from a declared target's view, a bind group for instance, rebuilds it when the count changes.

slots.name: join_chain
slots.doc: Gives a pass a place in the chain, after every pass that joined the same stage before it. The place is kept until leave_chain.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK, or KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a stage or mode out of range.

params.name: out_link
params.doc: Receives the link; KE_RENDER_CHAIN_NONE on failure.

slots.name: leave_chain
slots.doc: Gives the place back. An unknown link is ignored.

slots.name: chain_format
slots.doc: Texel format of the color a pass of stage draws into, the format its pipeline declares.

vtables.name: ke_render_camera
vtables.doc: The matrices and projection that a camera component and its world transform describe. Every slot is callable at any time and tolerates a null `self`, a null input or a null output by writing nothing.

slots.name: view
slots.doc: World-to-view for a camera placed by `camera_world`.

slots.name: view_rotation
slots.doc: The view matrix of `view` with its translation removed, leaving only the rotation.

slots.name: projection
slots.doc: The projection the camera describes. `orthographic` picks the kind, `orthographic_size` is half the visible height, and `fov` is the vertical field of view in degrees.

params.name: aspect
params.doc: Width over height of the surface drawn into.

slots.name: perspective_projection
slots.doc: A perspective projection from the camera's field of view, whatever its `orthographic` flag says.

params.name: aspect
params.doc: Width over height of the surface drawn into.

slots.name: perspective_frustum
slots.doc: The perspective frustum the camera's field of view describes, whatever its `orthographic` flag says.

params.name: aspect
params.doc: Width over height of the surface drawn into.

vtables.name: ke_render_camera_handle
vtables.doc: Owning wrapper: `ref` borrows for the lifetime, `destroy` ends it.

vtables.name: ke_render_frame
vtables.doc: The systems that begin and end a frame on the render service.

slots.name: frame_cid
slots.doc: The tag the system that begins the frame writes and the system that ends it reads. A pass that reads it runs inside the frame.

vtables.name: ke_render_scene_resolve
vtables.doc: The scene's render components and the update-phase systems that give a mesh and a sprite the GPU resources they name.

slots.name: component_ids
slots.doc: The ids of the components the scene resolve registered; valid while it lives.

lanes.name: result
lanes.doc: KE_OK, or the code of the compile that failed, whose reason is logged.

lanes.name: pso
lanes.doc: The pipeline; KE_GPU_INVALID_HANDLE when the compile failed.

callbacks.name: ke_gpu_buffer_mapped_func
callbacks.doc: Receives the outcome of mapping a buffer for reading.

lanes.name: result
lanes.doc: KE_OK when the range is readable through map_buffer until unmap_buffer, or the code of the mapping that failed.
